characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike orav nimega Ott, kellel on kohev punakaspruun saba, pehme oraanžikas karv, valge kõht, kollane kootud kampsun ja suured rõõmsad silmad. Armas ja sõbralik multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASSI
characters.description: Väike siil nimega Sassi, kellel on pehmed hallikaspruunid okkad, armas ümar nina, roheline kootud kampsun ja laia naeratusega nägu. Armas ja sõbralik multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: A cheerful sunny autumn garden with yellow and orange maple trees, green grass scattered with colorful fallen leaves, a cozy low wooden fence in the background, and a clean rainwater puddle on a dirt path in the center. Warm sunlight. Clean simple cartoon style.

pages.text: ORAV OTT JA SIIL SASSI MÄNGIVAD AIAS.
pages.scene: Orav Ott (a cute orange squirrel wearing a yellow sweater) and Siil Sassi (a cute hedgehog wearing a green sweater) are standing together in a sunny autumn garden, surrounded by green grass and colorful falling autumn leaves. Both characters are smiling happily. Landscape view, cheerful cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Siil Sassi stand near a big clear rainwater puddle on a dirt path in the autumn garden. They look at the puddle with excitement and wonder, pointing at the water. Golden tree leaves frame the top of the scene.

Orav Ott kneels on the grass and holds up a smooth piece of brown tree bark, showing it proudly to Siil Sassi. Siil Sassi stands beside him, smiling with delight. Autumn leaves scatter the green ground around them.

Siil Sassi carefully sticks a bright yellow maple leaf onto the piece of bark to serve as a sailboat sail, while Orav Ott holds the bark steady on the ground near the puddle. Both are focused and smiling.
Orav Ott and Siil Sassi hold the finished little toy sailboat together. The boat is made of bark with a tall yellow leaf sail. Both characters look proud and overjoyed.
Siil Sassi kneels gently at the edge of the clear rainwater puddle and places the small bark boat onto the water surface. Orav Ott watches enthusiastically right beside him.
The small bark sailboat with its bright yellow leaf sail floats gracefully across the clear puddle. Orav Ott and Siil Sassi walk happily along the edge of the puddle, watching their boat sail.

pages.text: OTT JA SASSI ON VÄGA ÕNNELIKUD.
pages.scene: Orav Ott and Siil Sassi jump for joy next to the puddle, holding hands and cheering warmly. The bark boat rests peacefully near the edge of the puddle in the sunny autumn garden.
